newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Philippine peso wedged in tight range, ends steady.
newsitem.headline: Philippine peso wedged in tight range, ends steady.

text.p: * Central Bank stays out of the market
The Philippine peso closed unchanged at 26.289 to the dollar after trading in a tight range throughout the session, traders said.
"It seems that the peso has reached an equilibrium at this point," one trader said.
The peso ranged between 26.288 to 26.290 for trades valued Thursday, while it was at 26.285 for trades valued today.
Importers were slowly buying dollars to cover their bills, while the steady inflow of overseas workers' remittances and portfolio investment easily covered the requirements, he said.
Oil companies bought $22.9 million at 26.289 to the dollar.
The Central Bank did not intervene in the market, keeping its buying rate at 26.265 and selling rate at 26.295.
Volume turnover was moderate with $169.20 million changing hands among banks.
The parallel market was treading sideways with rates ranging from 26.301 to 26.305.
